tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 named perfumes side by side: notes, longevity, projection, blind-buy safety, price and community evidence. tools.name: lookup_perfume
tools.description: Look up one perfume by name: concentration, scent family, notes pyramid, main accords, a one-line scent description, longevity, projection and blind-buy safety scores, price where known, community evidence and its scendira.com page. Returns close catalogue matches when the name is not found.
